headline: CSU Pueblo lose a second home match running
dek: Cal State San Bernardino won at CSU Pueblo, the second side to do so after Fort Lewis, and those are the only defeats in a season of thirteen wins and three draws. UCCS also lost, at Midwestern State, and Regis are now the only side in the conference with a match still listed.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 30; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: Regis have beaten Fort Lewis home and away, and have lost three times all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eight matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and fifteen defeats, the latest at home to Regis.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State have scored eight goals this season and conceded 50.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Regis's Jacobo Betancourt-Tovar has scored twelve goals this season from 67 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 72 saves this season and conceded 23 goals.

last_match.line: Cal State San Bernardino had already held Regis to a goalless draw in September.

next_match.line: Cal State LA beat Regis at home in September; Regis have not lost since UCCS beat them in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
